title: Teeny-Tiny
author: Joseph Jacobs
summary: 小小小妇人捡了一根坟上的骨头，夜里被小小的声音追着讨还。
publicDomainBasis: Published 1892; collected by Joseph Jacobs (1854–1916). Public domain in the United States and in China (author's life plus 70 years).

paragraphs.en: Once upon a time there was a teeny-tiny woman lived in a teeny-tiny house in a teeny-tiny village. Now, one day this teeny-tiny woman put on her teeny-tiny bonnet, and went out of her teeny-tiny house to take a teeny-tiny walk. And when this teeny-tiny woman had gone a teeny-tiny way she came to a teeny-tiny gate; so the teeny-tiny woman opened the teeny-tiny gate, and went into a teeny-tiny churchyard. And when this teeny-tiny woman had got into the teeny-tiny churchyard, she saw a teeny-tiny bone on a teeny-tiny grave, and the teeny-tiny woman said to her teeny-tiny self, "This teeny-tiny bone will make me some teeny-tiny soup for my teeny-tiny supper." So the teeny-tiny woman put the teeny-tiny bone into her teeny-tiny pocket, and went home to her teeny-tiny house.
paragraphs.zh: 从前，有一个小小小妇人，住在一个小小小村庄里的一栋小小小房子里。有一天，这个小小小妇人戴上她的小小小帽子，走出她的小小小房子，去散一个小小的步。这个小小小妇人走了小小小的一段路，来到一扇小小小门前；于是她打开小小小门，走进一个小小小墓地。她走进小小小墓地后，看见一座小小小坟上有一根小小小骨头，便对她的小小小自己说：“这根小小小骨头可以给我做一小小小锅汤，当我的小小小晚饭。”于是她把那根小小小骨头放进她的小小小口袋，回她的小小小房子去了。

paragraphs.en: Now when the teeny-tiny woman got home to her teeny-tiny house she was a teeny-tiny bit tired; so she went up her teeny-tiny stairs to her teeny-tiny bed, and put the teeny-tiny bone into a teeny-tiny cupboard. And when this teeny-tiny woman had been to sleep a teeny-tiny time, she was awakened by a teeny-tiny voice from the teeny-tiny cupboard, which said:
paragraphs.zh: 这个小小小妇人回到她的小小小房子时，已经有点小小小累了；于是她走上小小小楼梯，来到小小小床边，把那根小小小骨头放进一个小小小碗柜。她刚睡了一小小小会儿，就被小小小碗柜里传来的一个小小小声音吵醒了，那声音说：

paragraphs.en: And this teeny-tiny woman was a teeny-tiny frightened, so she hid her teeny-tiny head under the teeny-tiny clothes and went to sleep again. And when she had been to sleep again a teeny-tiny time, the teeny-tiny voice again cried out from the teeny-tiny cupboard a teeny-tiny louder, "Give me my bone!"
paragraphs.zh: 这个小小小妇人有点小小小害怕，便把小小小脑袋缩进小小小被子底下，又睡着了。她又睡了一小小小会儿，小小小声音又从碗柜里传来，这次大了一小小小点：“把我的骨头还给我！”

paragraphs.en: This made the teeny-tiny woman a teeny-tiny more frightened, so she hid her teeny-tiny head a teeny-tiny further under the teeny-tiny clothes. And when the teeny-tiny woman had been to sleep again a teeny-tiny time, the teeny-tiny voice from the teeny-tiny cupboard said again a teeny-tiny louder,
paragraphs.zh: 这使小小小妇人又害怕了一小小小点，她把小小小脑袋往小小小被子底下又缩了一小小小截。她又睡了一小小小会儿，小小小碗柜里的声音又响了起来，又大了一小小小点：

paragraphs.en: And this teeny-tiny woman was a teeny-tiny bit more frightened, but she put her teeny-tiny head out of the teeny-tiny clothes, and said in her loudest teeny-tiny voice, "TAKE IT!"
paragraphs.zh: 小小小妇人又害怕了一小小小点，但她把小小小脑袋从被子里探出来，用她最大的小小小声音喊道：“拿去！”
